purpose: qualify the independently transported B3 ERK mode-specific chi_bio factors and complete 8D Chi_bio modal precursor by testing local convergence of the source-native nonlinear ODE to the frozen analytic generator

equilibrium_and_generator.Jacobian: analytic reaction-network Jacobian previously qualified against complex-step

amplitude_rule.safe_scale: min(||x_star||_2, 0.5 * a_positive), where a_positive is the largest positive amplitude before any component with negative direction reaches zero

pair_lane.eligible_pairs: every FRET-visible complex-conjugate pair from the frozen analytic B3 generator; no post-result pair selection
pair_lane.phase_rule: rotate reduced right eigenvector by exp(-i arg(C_r v)) so the linear FRET projection is real and positive at t=0
pair_lane.physical_direction: normalized real part of Q v_phase
pair_lane.linear_prediction: exact pair evolution in the physical stoichiometric subspace
metrics: relative Frobenius/L2 error of all 15 state displacements
relative L2 error of deterministic FRET displacement
pair_lane.implementation_self_check: pair analytic state evolution versus complete expm(J_r t) evolution from the same pair-subspace initial condition; relative state error <= 1e-9
pair_lane.primary_pass_rule: for every eligible pair, both all-state and FRET errors at 1e-4 must be lower than their corresponding errors at 1e-3; all values finite

full_modal_lane.physical_directions: the eight fixed independent source stoichiometric columns [0,2,4,6,8,10,12,14], normalized without outcome-dependent sign changes
metrics: relative Frobenius/L2 error of all 15 state displacements
relative L2 error of deterministic FRET displacement where its linear prediction norm is nonzero
full_modal_lane.primary_pass_rule: for all eight physical directions, all-state error at 1e-4 must be lower than at 1e-3; FRET error must also decrease when both frozen predictions have nonzero norm

real_pole_refusal_control.rule: a single real reduced-generator pole must still be refused by the scalar constructor

next_if_pass: formal ERK model-specific Chi_bio admission and cross-system scalar/modal transport disposition, then freeze ERK joint local-vs-realized response for Bio Chi transport
